title: Genesis 1:1 — blue, yellow and red stars locked among black hexagon patterns
summary: Under the heading Genesis 1:1 (English and Hebrew) one large pattern of tiny stars: blue, yellow and red Star-of-David shapes fitted together, with clusters of black hexagons filling the gaps between them. No explanatory words are given.

pictures.description: A large snowflake-like figure made of tiny dots/stars: a blue, a yellow and a red Star of David interlock around a centre, with about ten black hexagonal clusters filling the spaces around and between them.

uncertain: The slide gives no explanation of the pattern; the connection to the previous slide's 3 x 337 stars is not stated.
